actions.action: Replace destructive timeout with a protected pause.
actions.mechanism: Locally saved ticket selections survive masking; a visitor-created code unlocks them without an account.
actions.implementation: Offer three-, six-, or ten-minute reading intervals. On expiry, mask and silence content. Retain encrypted drafts locally for fifteen minutes; require codes to resume.
actions.check: Test five-minute reading tasks and simulated walkaways: count reconstruction, unlock interruptions, and seconds selections remain exposed, including ten minutes offline.
actions.risk: Forgotten codes prevent recovery; longer intervals increase exposure before masking.

actions.action: Collect personal details only at final checkout.
actions.mechanism: Separating ticket choices from sensitive checkout data limits what survives interruption without losing ticket-selection work.
actions.implementation: Keep personal details outside resumable drafts. Purge them on locking or starting over. Require explicit final confirmation; offline, preserve tickets without claiming payment success.
actions.check: Interrupt every checkout screen, then resume offline: tickets must survive, personal details must not reappear, and no unconfirmed purchase may submit.
actions.risk: Slow visitors may need to re-enter details after locking.

actions.action: Make starting fresh an isolated, accessible handoff.
actions.mechanism: A new visitor gets a separate session, never a continuation of whichever draft was last active.
actions.implementation: Provide persistent “Start new visit” and locked-screen “Resume with code” controls, accessible through touch, Back/Confirm navigation, and screen reader. Handoff clears visible content, audio queues, and navigation history.
actions.check: Alternate two visitors offline. After starting fresh, exercise Back, Confirm, and screen reader; none may reveal or submit the previous visitor’s data.
actions.risk: Without identification, arrival cannot be detected; exposure remains until masking or explicit handoff.
